title: R-167 two-sided Shubin graph statement correction
question: Does EXP-001103 accurately describe the reverse graph/form input issued by the current R-167 authority?
method: Read the authoritative R-167 synthesis note at the Shubin graph induction statement and its surrounding scope qualifiers.
Compare the exact two-sided notation and order range with the missing-input wording in EXP-001103.
Separate the issued graph equivalence from the still-uninstantiated harmonic-number form estimate and finite compression compatibility.
finding: The R-167 synthesis note explicitly states ||k_h^(m/2) psi||^2 asymsum sum_{|beta|+|alpha|/2 <= m} ||q^alpha p^beta psi||^2, 0<=m<=5, in both directions. Therefore EXP-001103's wording that R-167 does not issue a reverse graph/form estimate was too strong and is corrected here. The authority still does not name the harmonic number N, fix the constants and lower-order shifts needed for an explicit N^5 <= C(1+k_h^5) instantiation, or prove convergence of harmonic compressed polynomial powers to the exact k_h spectral/Ritz restriction.
decision_reason: Append-only correction of the source characterization. The two-sided Shubin graph input is retained as available analytic evidence, while the harmonic-number identification and cutoff compatibility remain open operator-domain gates.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing correction only. It neither closes the Q3 weighted top-tail theorem nor supplies source/volume/orientation/history uniformity, direct D or delta-D Cauchy convergence, common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, KMS/GNS reconstruction, a physical gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.

adversarial_review.check: The note's asymsim notation is read as a two-sided graph equivalence, not as a one-sided estimate.
A two-sided q,p graph estimate is not silently renamed a harmonic-number N estimate with uniform constants.
The exact spectral/Ritz restriction is kept distinct from powers of compressed q_n and p_n.
The correction does not promote finite-periodic R-167 moments to a Q3 all-exhaustion or QFT reconstruction theorem.

next_action: Instantiate an explicit N-versus-k_h form inequality with constants and prove a state-weighted harmonic-compression boundary estimate; otherwise record an exact obstruction before attempting D/delta-D or common-alpha promotion.
